patterns.note: The page uses a distinct full-width header and footer in a dark color, sandwiching a main content area with a vibrant background color.
A single, bold, vibrant background color dominates the main content area, providing a strong visual anchor for the page and high contrast for white text.
A very large, bold sans-serif headline is used to immediately convey the page's status, followed by smaller, legible body text and even smaller functional links.
No scroll-triggered motion; the design relies on static hierarchy and clear visual separation, with all content immediately visible or accessible through standard browser scrolling.

technique_notes: The page employs a static layout with a fixed header and footer, and a central content block that fills the remaining vertical space.
A vibrant, solid background color is used for the main content area to create a strong visual impact and differentiate it from the dark header and footer.
The motion system is entirely static, with no scroll-triggered animations or reveals; all content is immediately visible or accessible through standard browser scrolling.

design_tokens.type_scale: A very large, bold headline (approx. 3-4x body text size) is paired with a clear, readable body text and smaller, functional navigation/footer text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for the call-to-action button, otherwise sharp for most elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical padding around the main content block and within the footer columns, creating an airy feel.

standout: The use of a whimsical, colorful illustration of a musical instrument with flowers on an error page, combined with a bold, single-color background, transforms a potentially frustrating experience into a more playful and on-brand interaction.
